device: PINNED scroll cinema: 3 hand-illustrated acts (МІСТО -> РАЙОН -> ДІЛЯНКА) MATCH-CUT through a shared focal point (village dot -> home -> parcel, all authored at viewBox 500,300). The outgoing act scales UP and out (1 -> 2.6), the incoming act starts small (0.45) and settles to 1, both pivoting on the focal point -> a real continuous zoom, not three fades.
data_pipeline: SAME real-OSM bake as the smarts location map (region outline / highway / district / parcel coords); drawn light + simplified per act.
dive_scale: d = pos - i (clamped [-1,1]); passed act sc = 1 + d*1.6, incoming sc = 1 + d*0.55; opacity = 1 - |d| cross-dissolve; transform-origin 50% 50% = the shared focal point
dwell: scroll 0..1 -> act pos with a hold band per act (0.5/N) + a transition band between, so every act (esp. the plot payoff) holds on screen
draws: each act's river/roads/parcel/threads draw via stroke-dashoffset on arrival; RE-ARMED when the act is left, so it re-draws on backward+forward re-entry (scrub paradigm)
act3_composition: parcel centered on the focal point, dimension lines (45m x 50m = 2250 m2 = 22,5 сотки) attached to edges, nearest places tied to the parcel with dotted leader ticks

responsive.mobile: <880px: gsap.matchMedia -> static PAIRED cards [each act directly above its caption]

preserveAspectRatio: meet (viewBox 16:10 matches .ztd-acts aspect-ratio 16/10 -> uniform, circles round, no letterbox)
rail: breadcrumb (Місто/Район/Ділянка), buttons + aria, click jumps to the act's dwell centre, :focus-visible
